root_cause.text: In ext4, when splitting an unwritten extent during within-EOF direct I/O or writeback with dioread_nolock enabled, the code passed `EXT4_GET_BLOCKS_CONVERT` to `ext4_split_convert_extents()`, which caused the `EXT4_EXT_DATA_VALID2` flag to be set, leading to premature conversion of the entire on-disk extent to written even when the split failed, allowing stale data to be exposed.
root_cause.evidence: The patch removes `EXT4_GET_BLOCKS_CONVERT` from the flags passed to `ext4_split_convert_extents()` in the `EXT4_GET_BLOCKS_SPLIT_NOMERGE` path (line `flags | EXT4_GET_BLOCKS_CONVERT` changed to `flags`). It also modifies `ext4_split_convert_extents()` to only set `EXT4_EXT_DATA_VALID2` when `EXT4_GET_BLOCKS_CONVERT` is actually present (adding `if (flags & EXT4_GET_BLOCKS_CONVERT)` guard). The CVE description details the failure scenario where `ext4_split_extent_at()` fails with `-ENOSPC`, zeroes the first half but converts the entire on-disk extent to written due to `EXT4_EXT_DATA_VALID2`, while the extent status tree still marks the second half as unwritten, leading to stale data exposure if the subsequent I/O fails.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix ext4 extent splitting to properly handle the EXT4_GET_BLOCKS_UNWRIT_EXT flag by entering the same code path as CONVERT but conditionally setting the data valid flag.
intent_record.what: Modified the else-if condition in ext4_split_convert_extents to also match EXT4_GET_BLOCKS_UNWRIT_EXT, and split the assignment of split_flag so that EXT4_EXT_DATA_VALID2 is only set when EXT4_GET_BLOCKS_CONVERT is present.
intent_record.how: The change allows the branch to handle both splitting of unwritten extents (UNWRIT_EXT) and conversion to initialized (CONVERT). For UNWRIT_EXT alone, only EXT4_EXT_MARK_UNWRIT2 is set; EXT4_EXT_DATA_VALID2 is only added when converting to initialized.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix ext4 extent handling to not forcibly add EXT4_GET_BLOCKS_CONVERT flag when splitting unwritten extents, passing original flags instead to avoid unintended conversion.
intent_record.what: Changed the flags argument in the call to ext4_split_convert_extents from 'flags | EXT4_GET_BLOCKS_CONVERT' to just 'flags'.
intent_record.how: The function ext4_split_convert_extents no longer receives the EXT4_GET_BLOCKS_CONVERT flag forcibly added; it now uses the original flags from the caller, which may or may not include that flag, altering the conversion decision during extent splitting.
